scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file infra/.env logs -f xprem
scripts.build:qa: mkdir -p builds && APP_VARIANT=qa npx expo prebuild --clean -p android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --init-script ../gradle/google-mirror.init.gradle && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../builds/ota-demo-qa.apk
scripts.build:prod: mkdir -p builds && APP_VARIANT=production npx expo prebuild --clean -p android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --init-script ../gradle/google-mirror.init.gradle && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../builds/ota-demo-prod.apk
scripts.build:all: npm run build:qa && npm run build:prod
scripts.build:eas:all: npm run build:eas:qa -- --no-wait && npm run build:eas:prod -- --no-wait
